items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: The interviewer asks 'Dutch, what did you do?' and Speaker_04 responds about age relative to 'Donnelly', but the interviewee (Don Albert) does not mention Dutch or describe any personal relationship with him.

ctx.x: Hold the shotgun on there and make me walk around the block in my underwear. A little kid, man. I'd be maybe about six, seven, eight, nine years old. And I was so always proud of myself. And that walking around the block in my underclothes was the worst thing that could ever happen to me. Did the neighbors say anything? I guess the neighbors looked at him and laughed, I imagine. But I was too busy crying and noticing anybody looking at me.
Dutch, what did you do? Well, she was too young.
I'm eight years younger than Donnelly.
